sources.name: anudeepND whitelist
sources.note: Domains commonly caught by overzealous blocklists. Used only to find hosts that are missing from the catalog; the allowlist concept itself is not part of this repository.

sources.name: anudeepND optional
sources.note: Second anudeepND list. Grouped under the same maintainer; both files are read so their coverage differences stay visible.

sources.name: HotCakeX Microsoft Domains
sources.note: Root Microsoft-owned domains. Used to find service/product gaps; categories are assigned by rules or review, not by the source.

sources.name: HotCakeX Microsoft Domains - EASM
sources.note: External attack surface list including Microsoft-owned brands such as ZeniMax/Bethesda. Categories come from rules only; unmatched hosts go to review.

sources.name: proxy-exception-whitelists
sources.note: Developer tooling domains documented for corporate proxy exceptions. Used only to find software-category catalog gaps.

sources.name: GoodnessJSON PiHole whitelist
sources.note: Community allowlist forked from anudeepND. Used only for delta/gap discovery.

sources.name: GoodnessJSON PiHole optional list
sources.note: Optional community allowlist entries; expected to overlap heavily with existing sources.

sources.name: Ultimate Hosts Blacklist whitelist
sources.note: Mixed whitelist syntax; parser deliberately ignores ALL/REG/RZD rules, IPs and sample/local names.

sources.name: Keloran Pi-hole whitelist
sources.note: Small Pi-hole whitelist derived from/an adjacent to anudeepND-style allowlists. Mostly overlap; retained as a delta source.
